# DeepSeek V4 Flash 知识图谱

## Overview
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    V4F["DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731版"]
    Perf["性能显著提升"]
    Comp["超越 V4 Pro 预览版"]
    Model["模型规模较小"]
    Params["约 200‑300B 参数"]
    License["免费商用许可证"]
    Bench["多项评测（代码、网络安全）"]
    Agent["即将发布的智能体"]
    Future["后续强化学习提升"]

    V4F --> Perf
    Perf --> Comp
    V4F --> Model
    Model --> Params
    V4F --> License
    V4F --> Bench
    V4F --> Agent
    Agent --> Future
    Model --> Future
```

## Inference Configuration
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Inf["推理模式"]
    Low["low"]
    High["high"]
    Max["max（最佳性能）"]
    Temp["temperature = 1.0"]
    TopP["top_p = 0.95"]
    MaxLen["最大输出 ≈ 384K"]
    KV["KV cache FP8"]
    Block["block size = 256"]
    Compat["兼容 OpenAI API"]
    Think["思考模式（charter temperature）"]
    ThinkParam["设置 true / max"]

    Inf --> Low
    Inf --> High
    Inf --> Max
    Max --> Temp
    Max --> TopP
    Max --> MaxLen
    Max --> KV
    KV --> Block
    Max --> Compat
    Compat --> Think
    Think --> ThinkParam
```

## Deployment Pipeline
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Install["安装 DGMMFP8 kernel"]
    Kernel["针对 DeepSeek 优化"]
    HW["选择硬件：H100 / H200 / B200"]
    Precision["支持 FP8（默认）/ FP4（B200）"]
    ParamsSet["设置推理参数"]
    Run["执行推理"]
    Tools["使用 VLLM、sgline 等开源项目"]
    Debug["启用 debug / 投机解码"]
    FutureNV["NVF P4 精度即将发布"]
    Release["后续模型强化学习"]

    Install --> Kernel
    Kernel --> HW
    HW --> Precision
    Precision --> ParamsSet
    ParamsSet --> Run
    Run --> Tools
    Run --> Debug
    Debug --> FutureNV
    Run --> Release
```
